// Generated from packages/factory-runtime/workflows/managed_supervisor/managed_supervisor.workflow-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
digraph managed_supervisor {
    label = "managed_supervisor"
    workflow_source = "packages/factory-runtime/workflows/managed_supervisor/managed_supervisor.workflow-source.mjs"
    typed_action_transport_mode = "enforced"
    action_item_gate [shape="diamond" label="Action items unresolved?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    check_control_state [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_control_state_gate" label="Check control state" output_format="json" outputs="control_gate,control_state_action,control_state_reason,should_run,parse_error,state_path" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_root_dir="${repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_active [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_health_classifier" label="Lifecycle -> active" output_format="json" outputs="lifecycle_state,health_state" action_control_gate="${control_gate}" action_has_action_items="false" action_has_domain_failure="false" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="false" action_has_selected_work="true" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_blocked_platform [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_health_classifier" label="Lifecycle -> blocked_platform" output_format="json" outputs="lifecycle_state,health_state" action_control_gate="${control_gate}" action_has_action_items="${has_action_items}" action_has_domain_failure="false" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="true" action_has_selected_work="false" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_degraded [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_health_classifier" label="Lifecycle -> degraded" output_format="json" outputs="lifecycle_state,health_state" action_control_gate="${control_gate}" action_has_action_items="false" action_has_domain_failure="true" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="false" action_has_selected_work="true" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_domain_failure [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_failure_classifier" label="Classify domain failure" output_format="json" outputs="failure_classification,failure_reason" action_domain_error="${__composite_reason}" action_gate="${control_gate}" action_parse_error="${parse_error}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_idle [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_health_classifier" label="Lifecycle -> idle" output_format="json" outputs="lifecycle_state,health_state" action_control_gate="${control_gate}" action_has_action_items="false" action_has_domain_failure="false" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="false" action_has_selected_work="false" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_manifest_failure [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_failure_classifier" label="Classify manifest failure" output_format="json" outputs="failure_classification,failure_reason" action_domain_error="${manifest_error}" action_gate="manifest" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_paused [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_health_classifier" label="Lifecycle -> paused/draining" output_format="json" outputs="lifecycle_state,health_state" action_control_gate="${control_gate}" action_has_action_items="false" action_has_domain_failure="false" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="false" action_has_selected_work="false" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    classify_paused_failure [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_failure_classifier" label="Classify paused/draining as local control-state owner" output_format="json" outputs="failure_classification,failure_reason" action_domain_error="${control_state_action}:${control_state_reason}" action_gate="control_state" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    close_stale_merge_followups_on_idle [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.close_stale_merge_followups" label="Close stale merge follow-ups (idle path)" output_key="__close_stale_merge_followups_on_idle_result" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_stale_hours="24" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    control_state_gate [shape="diamond" label="Control state allows tick?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    domain_failure_gate [shape="diamond" label="Domain failure observed?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    done [shape="Msquare" recovery_sink_type="terminal" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    emit_run_summary [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_emit_run_summary" label="Emit structured managed run summary" output_key="managed_run_summary" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_action_item_count="${action_item_count}" action_control_gate="${control_gate}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_control_state_action="${control_state_action}" action_control_state_reason="${control_state_reason}" action_domain_result="${domain_result}" action_failure_classification="${failure_classification}" action_failure_reason="${failure_reason}" action_has_action_items="${has_action_items}" action_has_issue="${has_issue}" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="${has_open_upstream_bugs}" action_health_state="${health_state}" action_target_repo_compat="${target_repo}" action_instance_id="${instance_id}" action_kind_id="${kind_id}" action_latest_incidents="[]" action_lifecycle_state="${lifecycle_state}" action_manifest_error="${manifest_error}" action_manifest_ok="${manifest_ok}" action_oldest_work_age_seconds="0" action_open_upstream_bug_count="${open_upstream_bug_count}" action_open_upstream_bug_numbers="${open_upstream_bug_numbers}" action_parse_error="${parse_error}" action_queue_depth="${action_item_count}" action_selected_issue_number="${selected_issue_number}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" action_trust_domain="${trust_domain}" action_trust_role="${trust_role}" action_unresolved_actions="${action_item_count}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    evaluate_action_items [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_action_item_gate" label="Evaluate unresolved action items" output_format="json" outputs="has_action_items,action_item_count" action_snapshot="${state_snapshot}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    evaluate_open_bug_gate [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.open_bug_gate" label="Evaluate open bug gate" output_format="json" outputs="has_open_bugs,open_bug_count,parse_error" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    evaluate_upstream_blockers [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.upstream_bug_gate" label="Evaluate upstream managed blockers" output_format="json" outputs="has_open_upstream_bugs,open_upstream_bug_count,open_upstream_bug_numbers,parse_error" action_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_label_filters="[\"managed-factory-bug\",\"kind:${kind_id}\"]" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    intake_gate [shape="diamond" label="Intake work selected?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    load_context [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_load_context" label="Load managed kind + instance context" output_format="json" outputs="manifest_ok,manifest_error,factory_id,factory_root,kind_path,instance_path,kind_id,instance_id,target_repo,control_plane_repo,domain_graph,shared_supervisor_shell,destinations_json,intake_json,kind_context_json,trust_domain,trust_role" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_destinations_json="${destinations_json}" action_factory_root="${factory_root}" action_target_repo_compat="${target_repo}" action_instance_id="${instance_id}" action_instance_path="${instance_path}" action_kind_id="${kind_id}" action_kind_path="${kind_path}" action_root_dir="${repo}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" action_trust_domain="${trust_domain}" action_trust_role="${trust_role}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    manifest_gate [shape="diamond" label="Manifests valid?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    open_bug_gate [shape="diamond" label="Open bugs? (self-heal route)" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    persist_lifecycle_state [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_persist_state" label="Persist lifecycle state snapshot" output_format="json" outputs="ok,state_path,state_version,mirror_path,mirror_version,mirror_updated_at,mirror_error,lifecycle_state,lifecycle_reason,lifecycle_failure_classification,lifecycle_failure_reason,lifecycle_updated_at,blockers,unresolved_actions,queue_depth,oldest_work_age_seconds,latest_incidents,error,message" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_action_item_count="${action_item_count}" action_actor="managed_supervisor" action_failure_classification="${failure_classification}" action_failure_reason="${failure_reason}" action_has_action_items="${has_action_items}" action_has_open_upstream_bugs="${has_open_upstream_bugs}" action_instance_id="${instance_id}" action_latest_incidents="[]" action_lifecycle_reason="${failure_reason}" action_lifecycle_state="${lifecycle_state}" action_oldest_work_age_seconds="0" action_open_upstream_bug_count="${open_upstream_bug_count}" action_open_upstream_bug_numbers="${open_upstream_bug_numbers}" action_queue_depth="${action_item_count}" action_root_dir="${repo}" action_unresolved_actions="${action_item_count}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    run_domain_graph [type="pipeline" label="Run kind domain graph" export_keys="domain_result" fail_open="true" inherit_context="true" pipeline="${domain_graph}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    select_intake [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.managed_intake_selector" label="Select next intake unit" output_format="json" outputs="has_issue,selected_issue_number,selected_issue_title,selected_issue_body,intake_json,parse_error" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_intake_json="${intake_json}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_empty_domain_result [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set empty domain result" output_key="domain_result" prompt="printf '{}'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_failure_classification_infrastructure [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set failure classification: infrastructure" output_key="failure_classification" prompt="printf 'infrastructure'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_failure_classification_none_manifest [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set failure classification: none (manifest path)" output_key="failure_classification" prompt="printf 'none'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_failure_reason_empty_manifest [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set empty failure reason (manifest path)" output_key="failure_reason" prompt="printf ''" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    set_failure_reason_upstream [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set failure reason: upstream blocker gate" output_key="failure_reason" prompt="printf 'open_upstream_bugs=%s issue_numbers=%s parse_error=%s' '${open_upstream_bug_count}' '${open_upstream_bug_numbers}' '${parse_error}'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    snapshot_state [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.state_snapshot" label="Load durable snapshot" output_key="state_snapshot" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    sweep_completed_goals_on_idle [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.sweep_completed" label="Sweep completed goals (idle path)" output_key="__sweep_completed_goals_on_idle_result" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_repo_root="${repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    upstream_gate [shape="diamond" label="Open upstream blockers?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    classify_degraded -> persist_lifecycle_state
    classify_idle -> set_empty_domain_result
    persist_lifecycle_state -> emit_run_summary -> done
    run_domain_graph -> classify_domain_failure -> domain_failure_gate
    set_empty_domain_result -> persist_lifecycle_state
    start -> load_context -> manifest_gate
    action_item_gate -> run_domain_graph [condition="has_action_items=true"]
    action_item_gate -> select_intake [condition="has_action_items!=true"]
    check_control_state -> control_state_gate
    classify_active -> persist_lifecycle_state
    classify_blocked_platform -> set_empty_domain_result
    classify_manifest_failure -> classify_degraded [condition="failure_classification!=none"]
    classify_manifest_failure -> set_failure_classification_none_manifest [condition="failure_classification=none"]
    classify_paused_failure -> set_empty_domain_result
    classify_paused -> classify_paused_failure
    close_stale_merge_followups_on_idle -> classify_idle
    control_state_gate -> classify_paused [condition="should_run!=true"]
    control_state_gate -> evaluate_upstream_blockers [condition="should_run=true"]
    domain_failure_gate -> classify_active [condition="failure_classification=none"]
    domain_failure_gate -> classify_degraded [condition="failure_classification!=none"]
    evaluate_action_items -> action_item_gate
    evaluate_open_bug_gate -> open_bug_gate
    evaluate_upstream_blockers -> upstream_gate
    intake_gate -> evaluate_open_bug_gate [condition="has_issue!=true"]
    intake_gate -> run_domain_graph [condition="has_issue=true"]
    manifest_gate -> classify_manifest_failure [condition="manifest_ok!=true"]
    manifest_gate -> snapshot_state [condition="manifest_ok=true"]
    open_bug_gate -> run_domain_graph [condition="has_open_bugs=true"]
    open_bug_gate -> sweep_completed_goals_on_idle [condition="has_open_bugs!=true"]
    select_intake -> intake_gate
    set_failure_classification_infrastructure -> set_failure_reason_upstream
    set_failure_classification_none_manifest -> set_failure_reason_empty_manifest [condition="failure_classification=none"]
    set_failure_reason_empty_manifest -> classify_idle [condition="failure_classification=none"]
    set_failure_reason_upstream -> classify_blocked_platform
    snapshot_state -> check_control_state
    sweep_completed_goals_on_idle -> close_stale_merge_followups_on_idle
    upstream_gate -> evaluate_action_items [condition="has_open_upstream_bugs!=true"]
    upstream_gate -> set_failure_classification_infrastructure [condition="has_open_upstream_bugs=true"]
}
